remarks: Serene ocean views that extend all the way to Catalina Island from the primary bedroom and living room will give you the unmistakable feeling of being on vacation every day in this beautifully remodeled retreat. Ideally positioned just a 10-minute jog to the coastline of Strands Beach and a 7-minute drive to Dana Point Harbor. This spacious end-unit townhome feels more like a private single-family residence, with generous indoor and outdoor spaces, and abundant privacy. Terraced entry through a gated courtyard and rich wood double doors welcome you home.
